Package gate.lang.json

package gate.lang.json
Provides JSON parsing, serialization, structural wrapping, typed encoding/decoding, and display-oriented rendering utilities.
Core operations exposed by JsonElement:
  • JsonElement.parse(String) and JsonElement.stringify(gate.lang.json.JsonElement) for JSON text
  • JsonElement.wrap(Object) and JsonElement.unwrap() for natural Java structural values
  • JsonElement.encode(Object) and JsonElement.decode(Class) for typed object conversion
  • JsonElement.render(Object) for human-oriented display rendering
Example: 
	JsonElement json = JsonElement.parse("{\"name\":\"Gate\",\"active\":true}");
	String string = JsonElement.stringify(json);
	Object value = json.unwrap();

	JsonElement wrapped = JsonElement.wrap(Map.of("name", "Gate"));
	JsonElement encoded = JsonElement.encode(new User());
	JsonElement rendered = JsonElement.render(true);
A JsonArray is a List of JsonElement and a JsonObject is a Map from String to JsonElement.
The JsonParser provides a way to read JsonElement values sequentially from a Reader.
